title: 美联储主席戴利：专注本职，不操心财政部
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: President Daly, I can imagine you'd love to avoid all the conversation about Treasury, the Department and issuance, but forgive me, I have to go there. There are many people who believe
segments.zh: 戴利行长，我想您可能不想讨论财政部和债券发行的话题，但请原谅，我不得不提。很多人认为

segments.en: will see a continuation of this Treasury Department under Scott Besson of the policies that we saw under Janet Yellen and that will see less issuance of the long end and more supply at the front end.
segments.zh: 在斯科特·贝森特领导下的财政部，将继续延续耶伦时期的政策，减少长期债券发行，增加短期债券供应。

segments.en: If T Bill issuance continues to climb and account for more and more of the issuance coming from the Treasury, President Daly, how does that change your view on what to do and what not to do with
segments.zh: 如果短期国库券发行持续增加，并在财政部发行中占比越来越大，戴利行长，这会如何改变您对政策操作的观点？

segments.en: policy? What does it mean for the everyday workings of the Federal Reserve, who is very focused on managing short-term rates? Well I'd say these are early days and I wouldn't want to be preemptive
segments.zh: 这对美联储的日常运作意味着什么？美联储非常关注短期利率管理。我认为现在还为时过早，我不想在充分思考这些问题之前就预先判断。

segments.en: in sort of discussing those types of things until we've had a chance to think through those issues, but you know the Treasury Secretary is different than the Fed. The Fed is talking about price
segments.zh: 但您知道，财政部长和美联储不同。美联储关注的是价格稳定和充分就业，而且我们历史上一直能够做到的是，我们有目标，并且可以通过政策实施来实现这些目标。

segments.en: stability and full employment and what I do know is and we've historically been able to do this is we have a goal and we can achieve those goals through our policy implementation and we will
segments.zh: 我们会找到办法完成国会赋予我们的任务，即将通胀恢复到2%，我们的目标就是实现价格稳定。所以我认为，我们不应过多担心实现目标的具体机制，而应关注实现目标的承诺。

segments.en: find a way to do the job that Congress gave us which is restore inflation to 2% and our goal is we define it and do that price stability. So I think we don't want to worry about the mechanics
segments.zh: 请原谅我追问，但这是否与您要实现的目标相冲突？当您看到财政部……

segments.en: of how to do that as much as the commitment to achieve it. Forgive me for going there, but is it in conflict with what you're trying to achieve? When you see the Treasury Department
segments.zh: 我认为最终这非常重要，但这是财政部长的职责，而不是美联储的职责。我们有自己非常重要的职责，而且我们……

segments.en: I think you know ultimately I think this is really important but it's the Treasury Secretary's job not not the Federal Reserve's job and we have our own job which is very important but also we're
segments.zh: 我认为最终这很重要，但这是财政部长的职责，不是美联储的职责。我们有自己的职责，这也很重要，而且我们还在……
